blocks.text:
## Rio for a corporate trip

Rio de Janeiro lets you combine business with leisure without long journeys between cities. Its conference venues and hotels are in a city where, after work meetings, you can reach the main viewpoints, a beach or the historic districts in a matter of hours.

Rio is suited to meetings, conferences, exhibitions and incentive trips. The city offers modern venues, high-quality hotels and transport facilities for international groups. After business events, it is easy to add guided tours, time on the beach, dining and entertainment to the programme.

The city lies between mountains, the bay and the Atlantic Ocean. Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon offer time by the water, while Corcovado and Sugar Loaf reveal Rio from above.

Activities for corporate groups can be added to the programme, including beach walks, samba lessons and other experiences related to Brazilian culture. The trip is designed to keep work and leisure in one city, without additional complex logistics.

Group lunches and dinners are planned at Confeitaria Colombo, Rio Scenarium, Caixa de Oriente, Marius Seafood, Palace Grill and Assador. Ada Tours may change their order while retaining the overall programme.
